name: The Nutcracker
description:
Schuylkill Valley Regional Dance Company

Schuylkill Valley Regional Dance Company will be performing the Nutcracker at the Hill School Center for the Arts. Join a cast of over 80 local dancers and guest artists, such as Ruben Ybarra from the Pennsylvania Academy of Ballet, on December 5 at 7:30pm and December 6 at 2:00pm. Enjoy this classic family favorite with beautifully enhanced choreography by Michelle Jones Wurtz, as well as former Kirov principals Elena Martinson and Andrei Ustinov, just in time for the holidays.

Tickets are available for advanced purchase on www.danceboxoffice.com, as well as area locations, such as Pottstown Dance Theatre, Gallery on High, All That Jazz (Collegeville), Pack & Ship at Coventry Mall, and National Penn Bank (Coventry). You can also purchase them at the Hill School box office, based on availability. Tickets cost $20.00 for adults and $15.00 for students and seniors. Discounts available for groups of 10 or more Mastercard and Visa accepted.

For additional information on purchasing Nutcracker tickets, the premiere of Just Dance! in the brand new Tri-County Performing Arts Center, or how you can become a supporter of the arts right here in the Pottstown area, please call 484.941.0683 or send an email to thesvrdc@yahoo.com. You can also visit us at www.svrdc.org, Facebook and Twitter.

name: "12 Pubs of Christmas" Charity Bar Crawl!
description:
Grab your holiday sweaters and join Run 2 Inspire for a FESTIVE holiday bar crawl! Benefits a great cause! you DO NOT want to miss this event!

Grab your holiday sweaters and join Run 2 Inspire as we gallivant around the city of Philadelphia spreading holiday cheer and raising awareness for HPV and cervical cancer!

Run 2 Inpire is a Philadelphia non-profit whose mission is to raise awareness and education for cancer below the waist! (HPV & Cervical Cancer)

$15 donation gets you a t-shirt, wrist band, drink specials at all 12 bars and an entry into our special Bar Crawl Challenge. We will also provide light appetizers and assorted food at a couple of stops during our crawl.

So grab a friend and come out to celebrate the holidays with us!

Bars scheduled to participate in the Pub Crawl include:

Fado
Irish Pub
Tir Na Nog
Misconduct
Devil's Alley
McGillian's

To order tickets visit: http://r2ibarcrawl.eventbrite.com

name: Triumph Brewing Company presents THINK PINK FLOYD
description:
THINK PINK FLOYD is THE ULTIMATE PINK FLOYD TRIBUTE BAND

http://www.thinkpinkfloyd.com
http://www.facebook.com/THINKPINKFLOYD1
http://www.youtube.com/thinkpinkfloyd

A live tribute to Pink Floyd from the Meddle album to the Division Bell era,
(and everything in between)
THINK PINK FLOYD is the most popular Pink Floyd tribute show,
authentic recreation of PINK FLOYD.

THINK PINK FLOYD has been featured in OUT ON THE TOWN ENTERTAINMENT NEWS
The band’s greatest thrill has been the diverse repertoire of classic Pink Floyd songs ,venues that request their return and the tons of new fans who instantly fall in love with the band.

People we get out to our events are
true Pink Floyd fans from the area and beyond.

People really enjoy the music of Pink Floyd.

Their music was magical, epic, psychedelic with
awesome musicianship and bizarre imagery in the lyrics.

THINK PINK FLOYD performs the favorites that all pink Floyd fans recognize.
******Seduced by a journey through sound & lights******
Fog flows across a the stage.
as
the band kicks into the DARK SIDE OF THE MOON....

Think Pink Floyd has built up an enormous repertoire with
about four hours of vintage Floyd material to choose from.
And the band really has all the bases covered:
From the young Pink Floyd’s "meddle" echeo's” (1971)
through the ”Dark Side Of The Moon” (1973), ”Wish You Were Here”
(1975) Animals (1977)”The Wall” (1979) ”A Momentary Lapse Of Reason”
(1987) and ”The Division Bell” (1994). plus much more syd and roger legendary music,
a kick ass band and a unique sound, light and film show.(((((Think Pink Floyd)))))
